lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਰੈ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)kat nahee parai jon nahee aavai naam nira(n)jan jaa ko re ||
lines.translation: He does not fall into misfortune, and He does not take birth; His Name is the Immaculate Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਐਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਈ ਨ ਬਾਪੋ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੭੦॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ko suaamee aiso thaakur jaa kai maaee na baapo re ||2||19||70||
lines.translation: Kabeer's Lord is such a Lord and Master, who has no mother or father. ||2||19||70||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee ||
lines.translation: Gauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਉ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਲੋਗੁ ਨਿੰਦਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dau ni(n)dau mo kau log ni(n)dau ||
lines.translation: Slander me, slander me - go ahead, people, and slander me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਖਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa jan kau kharee piaaree ||
lines.translation: Slander is pleasing to the Lord's humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਾਪੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa baap ni(n)daa mahataaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Slander is my father, slander is my mother. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa hoi ta baiku(n)th jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: If I am slandered, I go to heaven;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath manahi basaaeeai ||
lines.translation: the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਦੈ ਸੁਧ ਜਉ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ridai sudh jau ni(n)daa hoi ||
lines.translation: If my heart is pure, and I am slandered,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਕਪਰੇ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hamare kapare ni(n)dak dhoi ||1||
lines.translation: then the slanderer washes my clothes. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa karai s hamaraa meet ||
lines.translation: One who slanders me is my friend;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak maahi hamaaraa cheet ||
lines.translation: the slanderer is in my thoughts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਸੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak so jo ni(n)daa horai ||
lines.translation: The slanderer is the one who prevents me from being slandered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਲੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hamaraa jeevan ni(n)dak lorai ||2||
lines.translation: The slanderer wishes me long life. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਮਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa hamaree prem piaar ||
lines.translation: I have love and affection for the slanderer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਕਰੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa hamaraa karai udhaar ||
lines.translation: Slander is my salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan kabeer kau ni(n)daa saar ||
lines.translation: Slander is the best thing for servant Kabeer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਡੂਬਾ ਹਮ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥੨੦॥੭੧॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak doobaa ham utare paar ||3||20||71||
lines.translation: The slanderer is drowned, while I am carried across. ||3||20||71||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਤੂੰ ਐਸਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam too(n) aisaa nirabhau taran taaran raam raaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O my Sovereign Lord King, You are Fearless; You are the Carrier to carry us across, O my Lord King. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਬ ਤੁਮ ਹਹੁ ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab ham hote tab tum naahee ab tum hahu ham naahee ||
lines.translation: When I was, then You were not; now that You are, I am not.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਦੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ab ham tum ek bhae hahi ekai dekhat man pateeaahee ||1||
lines.translation: Now, You and I have become one; seeing this, my mind is content. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਬ ਬਲੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਅਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲੁ ਨ ਖਟਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab budh hotee tab bal kaisaa ab budh bal na khataaee ||
lines.translation: When there was wisdom, how could there be strength? Now that there is wisdom, strength cannot prevail.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਦਲੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer budh har laee meree budh badalee sidh paaee ||2||21||72||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, the Lord has taken away my wisdom, and I have attained spiritual perfection. ||2||21||72||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee ||
lines.translation: Gauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਬੀਚ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khat nem kar kothaRee baa(n)dhee basat anoop beech paaee ||
lines.translation: He fashioned the body chamber with six rings, and placed within it the incomparable thing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਜੀ ਕੁਲਫੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ku(n)jee kulaph praan kar raakhe karate baar na laaee ||1||
lines.translation: He made the breath of life the watchman, with lock and key to protect it; the Creator did this in no time at all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮਨ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab man jaagat rahu re bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Keep your mind awake and aware now, O Sibling of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaaphal hoi kai janam gavaaio chor musai ghar jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You were careless, and you have wasted your life; your home is being plundered by thieves. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਪਹਰੂਆ ਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch paharooaa dar mahi rahate tin kaa nahee pateeaaraa ||
lines.translation: The five senses stand as guards at the gate, but now can they be trusted?

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਚਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਲੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਉਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chet suchet chit hoi rahu tau lai paragaas ujaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: When you are conscious in your consciousness, you shall be enlightened and illuminated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਘਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੁ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nau ghar dekh j kaaman bhoolee basat anoop na paaee ||
lines.translation: Seeing the nine openings of the body, the soul-bride is led astray; she does not obtain that incomparable thing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਵੈ ਘਰ ਮੂਸੇ ਦਸਵੈਂ ਤਤੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥੨੨॥੭੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer navai ghar moose dasavai(n) tat samaaee ||3||22||73||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, the nine openings of the body are being plundered; rise up to the Tenth Gate, and discover the true essence. ||3||22||73||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee ||
lines.translation: Gauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee mohi avar na jaanio aanaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: O mother, I do not know any other, except Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਜਾਸੁ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਾਸੁ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੋਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: siv sanakaad jaas gun gaavahi taas basahi more praanaanaa(n) || rahaau ||
lines.translation: My breath of life resides in Him, whose praises are sung by Shiva and Sanak and so many others. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੰਮਿਤ ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: hirade pragaas giaan gur ga(n)mit gagan ma(n)dal mahi dhiaanaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: My heart is illuminated by spiritual wisdom; meeting the Guru, I meditate in the Sky of the Tenth Gate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਰੋਗ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਾਗੇ ਮਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bikhai rog bhai ba(n)dhan bhaage man nij ghar sukh jaanaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: The diseases of corruption, fear and bondage have run away; my mind has come to know peace in its own true home. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਰਤਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੂਸਰ ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਆਨਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek sumat rat jaan maan prabh doosar manahi na aanaanaa ||
lines.translation: Imbued with a balanced single-mindedness, I know and obey God; nothing else enters my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਬਾਸੁ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਘਟਿਓ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)dan baas bhae man baasan tiaag ghatio abhimaanaanaa ||2||
lines.translation: My mind has become fragrant with the scent of sandalwood; I have renounced egotistical selfishness and conceit. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਗਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੈ ਥਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan gaai dhiaai jas thaakur taas prabhoo hai thaanaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: That humble being, who sings and meditates on the Praises of his Lord and Master, is the dwelling-place of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਬਡ ਭਾਗ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਮਥਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tih bad bhaag basio man jaa kai karam pradhaan mathaanaanaa ||3||
lines.translation: He is blessed with great good fortune; the Lord abides in his mind. Good karma radiates from his forehead. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਹਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaat sakat siv sahaj pragaasio ekai ek samaanaanaa ||
lines.translation: I have broken the bonds of Maya; the intuitive peace and poise of Shiva has dawned within me, and I am merged in oneness with the One.
